recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Revisit only if a future work group decision requests a different sort mode or if the publisher-generated profile list demonstrably omits a current build-scope profile.
issue_request: FHIR-5552 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 change request asking for easier navigation to profiles from the FHIR home page, suggesting a resource-list-like page that lists profiles so users do not need to know the primary related resource first.
initial_application: The Jira application comment cites svn revision 5097. In the git-svn history, commit c904562daa8a60d6085aa050a721cfee073e2882 (#5552 - adjust resourcelist) changed source/resourcelist.html and publish.ini to improve resource-list/profile navigation for the then-current DSTU1 profile set; source/profilelist.html already existed at that point.
additional_context: Current source/profilelist.html contains the <%profilelist%> publisher placeholder, source/hierarchy.xml places profilelist.html under the Table of Contents, tools/templates/newnavbar.html links it from the global Artifacts menu that appears on the home page, and publish.ini includes profilelist.html. The current CI build renders this as a Profiles page with a generated profile table. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-5552 found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Adding another home-page or resource-list link would duplicate the existing global navigation and would not correct a current semantic or build-scope defect.
